name: Calendly
one_liner: Online scheduling tool for booking meetings and managing availability.
access_notes: Basic REST API (GET/POST) works on any plan including Free, via OAuth2 or a personal access token. Webhooks and Scheduling API endpoints require a paid plan (Professional/Standard/Standard Plus/Teams/Teams Plus/Enterprise); some org-level endpoints (activity logs, data deletion) are Enterprise-only.

evidence.quote: Each request is secured with a personal access token (PAT), which lets the API know what you're allowed to do.
can also integrate your app using OAuth 2.0 for secure authorization
Developers can make GET and POST requests to API endpoints on behalf of a Calendly user on any subscription plan, including the Free plan
The Calendly user account for which the webhook subscription is being made will need a paid subscription on the Standard, Teams, or Enterprise plan.
Subscribe to Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker events and get real-time notifications the moment they happen.
The server is fully hosted by Calendly at https://mcp.calendly.com.
Calendly MCP uses Dynamic Client Registration (DCR), which means you do not need to pre-register an OAuth application
Developers can make GET and POST requests to API endpoints on behalf of a Calendly user on any subscription plan

name: Cal.com
one_liner: Open-source scheduling platform with a REST API for bookings, event types, availability, and calendar sync.
access_notes: Cal.com's API v2 docs state auth is via Bearer API key (generated in Settings > Developer > API Keys) or OAuth; API key creation appears available on any account. However, the official pricing page explicitly lists 'Custom APIs' as a Teams-plan feature and 'Additional APIs' under Organizations, which contradicts the docs' implication of universal API-key access. This discrepancy was not fully resolved from official sources alone (one supporting data point came from a WebSearch synthesis, not a directly fetched quote) — flagging for human review. Separately, Cal.com also sells a distinct 'Platform API' product for embedding scheduling into third-party apps, priced from $299/month — that is unrelated to the general REST API key access described above.

evidence.quote: Remove Cal.com branding, Routing forms, Booking analytics, Custom APIs
Connect AI clients to Cal.com scheduling through the Model Context Protocol using the hosted server at mcp.cal.com or a local instance.
Teams customers: All endpoints except Platform and Orgs
